caption: The drawing depicts a detailed brown saddle with elaborate floral and geometric carvings on its leather surfaces. The saddle is positioned in profile, showing the horn at the front, the seat, and the back cantle, as well as the skirts on both sides. The saddle is adorned with intricate tooling on most leather parts, including the fenders, skirt, and the pommel. Silver accents are visible on the horn and the top rear edge of the saddle. The stirrup on the viewer’s left is metallic with a rectangular shape, hanging from a tooled leather strap. Attached below the saddle is a wool or woven girth strap, banded in cream and brown, with a small black tassel hanging underneath. Several leather straps and latigos hang loosely from the saddle. The entire composition is centered on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Saddle
